title: Plastic like material, kind of think...
text: Plastic like material, kind of think.... Not super crazy about this one. I like the rings on top but that's about it. Not great at blocking out light, not great looking. Just meh all around. As a result, I would say this one is not a great value for what you pay.

product_metadata.title: Sun Smart Blakesly Blackout Curtains Patio Window, Ikat Print, Grommet Top Living Room Decor, Living Room Decor, Thermal Insulated Light Blocking Drape for Bedroom and Apartments, 50" x 84", Taupe
features: Patio blinds features a printed aqua ikat design on a textured base fabric, creating dimension for a cool and casual look.
Blackout foamback liner offers privacy and noise reduction and maintains room temperature for energy efficiency.
Easy to use silver gromment top fits up to 1. 25" diameter rod
1 Single Window Panel: 50"W x 84"L, as shown in image - Need to purchase 2 curtain Panel for each Single Window for standard coverage.
description: Introducing a modern and stylish take on energy efficiency, our SUN SMART Blakesly Printed Ikat Blackout Panel is the perfect update to any room. Fresh and chic, this Single Window panel features a printed taupe ikat design on a textured firm base fabric, creating dimension for a cool and casual look. Finished with a two pass foamback and bonding technique, the panel is enhanced to block most sunlight and create a significant barrier to reduce outside noise. Silver grommet top detail makes it easy to hang, open, and close Panel throughout the day; while fitting up to a standard 1.25” diameter rod. With considerable energy savings and a high level of added privacy, this blackout panel is perfect for home offices, family rooms, and bedrooms. Give your space a beautiful, one-of-a-kind update with this contemporary blackout Single Window panel. Lighting level: Heavily Shaded Ambiance.
